what: replication of arXiv:2509.26507 section 7.1 model merging, on our own checkpoints
paper_recipe: concatenate every tensor with an n dimension (D_x, D_y, E, RoPE frequency buffers); average the rest (embeddings, lm_head)
paper_precondition: the paper's two models are CLONES of a common En-Es base (section 7.1 steps 1-3). Ours were trained independently from scratch, so they share no neuron basis.
our_eval_caveat: mean next-byte cross-entropy over 4 short probe sentences per language, NOT a held-out validation corpus. Chance is ln(256)=5.545. Not comparable to the paper's Table 2 numbers in absolute terms.
